items.label: Trend change
items.title: Baseline established at 246 mentions
items.body: The rolling three-month view averages two mentions per day. This is the baseline; the first week-on-week change will appear after the next scheduled refresh.

items.label: Core topics
items.title: Education and study lead the conversation
items.body: Colleges and universities is the largest topic, followed by study abroad and AI and machine learning. These three themes account for the clearest share of current discussion.

items.label: Coverage themes
items.title: Design education connects confirmed and organic coverage
items.body: Confirmed coverage centres on art and design education, urban change and industry practice, while organic pickup also extends into study pathways, AI-enabled creativity and design careers.
evidence: Campaign theme: From Building to Creating
Organic mentions include study, AI and design career topics

items.label: Pre-brand visibility
items.title: RMIT appears in 68% of valid pre-brand answers
items.body: Across prompts that did not name RMIT, 59 of 87 valid model answers mentioned the university. This is the baseline for the next monthly comparison.

items.label: Audience gap
items.title: Awareness is weakest for parents and postgraduates
items.body: Awareness-stage naming is 4 of 15 for parents and 3 of 14 for postgraduate and early-career audiences, below the prospective undergraduate result of 9 of 14.

items.label: Content opportunity
items.title: Twenty-five answers still name no provider
items.body: The open category is concentrated before brand-led prompts, indicating room for clearer proof around practical learning, industry links and graduate outcomes.
evidence: Conversion prompts excluded from pre-brand measure
